notes.title: Announcement
notes.content:
Although we initially planned to launch All-Age version of Kunoichi Tsubaki and release the free R-18 DLC, the All-Age version has been banned by Steam and its DLC can no longer be released.
Though we will continue trying to find a way to make it,
we regret to inform you that this is out of our control.

notes.title: Version Update Info (2/22/2019)
notes.content:
We are planning on updating this game to an All-Age version
with the R18 content provided freely as a separate DLC.

There will be two methods for applying the R18 content to the game.

- Install the DLC that will be made available on Steam.
(It will be made available concurrently with the update.)

- Download the DLC from DLsite's Patch Plaza and apply.
https://www.dlsite.com/modpub/patch-plaza/index.html

The All Ages Ver folder will be located in your Steam installation directory.
The DLC data will overwrite the data in this folder to add the R18 content.
Currently, your save data will be located in the "www\save" folder.
Please make a backup of this and copy it to the "All Ages Ver\www\save" folder
if you wish to keep your progress and continue after the update.

notes.title: Regarding Mature Content
notes.content: This game contains mature content intended for adults only. It does not require any external patches to gain access to that content.
